#### Following the door

The door (@exm-door-machine) starts closed, and these actions are done in this order:

$$
\mathtt{l}, \mathtt{o}, \mathtt{u}, \mathtt{o}, \mathtt{l}.
$$

Write down the whole sequence of conditions the door passes through,
starting with the condition it is in before the first action.

:::
